spans.s:
ऋक्थं [ऋच्-थक्]
1 Wealth.
--2
Especially, property, possessions,
effects (left at death); see रिक्थ.
--3
Gold.
--Comp.
--आदानः an
inheritor, heir.
--ग्रहणं receiving or
inheriting property.
--ग्राहः an
inheritor or receiver of property.
--भागः {1} division of property,
partition. {2} a share, inheritance.
--भागिन्, --हर, --हारिन् m. {1} an heir.
{2} a co-heir.
